decisive_items: Earlobe tissue fluid showed acid-fast bacilli (Bacterial Index 4.8)
Mild hypoaesthesia on the extensor side of the knee and ankle
response.rationale: The histopathologic finding of abundant acid-fast bacilli within histiocytes and the high bacterial index in earlobe tissue fluid are pathognomonic for leprosy, supported by mild hypoaesthesia. Sarcoidosis and lupus lack acid-fast bacilli and are contradicted by this definitive infectious marker.

rejected.why: Storiform histiocytic infiltrate is suggestive but contradicted by abundant acid-fast bacilli, which are not seen in sarcoidosis.
Positive autoantibodies are nonspecific and do not explain the acid-fast bacilli or histiocytic infiltrate; lupus does not present with such bacillary findings.
